purpose: Adjudicate possible common original publications missed by zero direct TRY-directory DOI hyperlinks, WITHOUT trait values, K outcomes or cross-compilation measurement-identity claims.

try_public_directory_artifact.describes: Historical TRY v6 public Explorer, not current TRY v7

austraits_core_source_artifact.describes: AusTraits fixed 254 family×trait K core contributing source IDs

matching_rules.tokenization: casefold ASCII alphabetic words from TRY title, exact normalized surname token only
matching_rules.strong_citation_candidate: TRY public dataset title explicitly contains the same surname token AND the exact four-digit publication year from AusTraits dataset ID
matching_rules.weak_citation_candidate: TRY public dataset title contains the exact surname token, but not the source-ID publication year; treat as lexical research lead only
matching_rules.doi_enrichment: Do not infer a TRY DOI from its DatasetID or title; separately preserve the independently recovered AusTraits publication DOI and actual TRY hyperlink DOIs, if any
matching_rules.ambiguous_year: Never treat absent or different TRY title year as a source independence PASS
